newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kampo says mulling suspending trade with Yamaichi.
newsitem.headline: Kampo says mulling suspending trade with Yamaichi.

text.p: Japan's Postal Life Insurance Bureau (Kampo) is considering suspending portfolio business with Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd, a Kampo official said on Wednesday.

"Given the raid (by prosecutors) on Yamaichi Securities' headquarters, we feel that we will have no choice but to stop transactions with them if they are found guilty of wrongdoing," a Kampo official said.
The official said Kampo would not be able to explain itself to policy-holders if it continued to deal with a financial institution which suspected of paying money to a corporate racketeer.
Kampo had investment assets worth 97.22 trillion yen as of end-February 1997.
Securities investments, in instruments such as Japanese government bonds, municipal bonds, corporate bonds and foreign bonds, accounted for more than half of its total investments.
